lead_headline: Lycian Way and Yörük Migration in Kaş
lead_deck: The traditional Lycian Way Hike and Patara Yörük Migration event was held in Kaş.
lead_body: The event, organised by the municipality, featured hiking and migration activities reflecting the region's cultural heritage.
Participants relived the Lycian Way Hike and Patara Yörük Migration tradition by walking along the Lycian Way route.
